name: su_Pt8_CeO2_111
title: Pt8 / CeO2(111)
description: Pt8 on a frozen O-terminated CeO2(111) slab (3 O-Ce-O trilayers, 5x5 cell, 225 atoms). The same host is used in the original Pt10 benchmark. Earlier pilot runs found a planar Pt8 minimum; the fixed, charge-neutral NEP89 model does not describe ceria reduction or oxygen vacancies.
